lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements all acceptance criteria for PMAT-3968. The GPU-whitelisted quant types are now derived from the census via `gguf_census.py` and measured through `bound_gemv` against the CPU decoder. The `shape_conformance_tests.rs` correctly implements the negative control per type, ensuring a blind type licenses nothing. The guard script `check_gpu_shape_conformance.sh` validates receipts and censuses, and correctly identifies unproven shapes, missing/stale/blind receipts, and stale per-capability exclusions (with a comprehensive self-test). Finally, `IQ3_S` and `IQ2_S` are correctly refused at cc >= 12, the contract reflects this, and the guard script guarantees the exclusion cannot outlive its fix. No refuting findings were identified.

PMAT-3968 passes review. The diff implements per-shape GPU conformance and per-capability quant exclusions as specified in the ticket and cop ruling (b). Specifically:

1. Census-Derived Shapes: `scripts/lib/gguf_census.py` reads headers of held GGUF models directly, producing machine-verified censuses for lambda (27 files) and gx10 (18 files) totaling 188 unique whitelisted (qtype, k, n) shapes.
2. Production Dispatch Measurement: `shape_conformance_tests.rs` exercises all 188 shapes via `BoundWeight::bind` and `CudaExecutor::bound_gemv` against the CPU oracle with condition-aware scaling (|err| / Σ|w||x| <= 1e-5). Worst measured error across both hosts is 1.302e-7. Negative controls per quant type corrupt block 0 of row 0 in GPU memory, confirming failure sensitivity (17/17 RED on lambda; 15/17 RED on gx10, where the 2 unexecuted controls correspond to excluded types).
3. CC >= 12 Exclusions: Types 21 (IQ3_S) and 22 (IQ2_S) are excluded at compute capability >= 12 (`GPU_QTYPES_UNLOADABLE_AT_CC` and `GPU_QTYPE_EXCLUSION_MIN_CC_MAJOR` in `dtype.rs`) due to sm_12x ModuleLoad 218 errors (#4096). The gate fails closed if capability query fails. The contract YAML and `apr capability` CLI are synced and verified by unit tests and mirror tests.
4. Conformance Checker and Anti-Staleness: `scripts/check_gpu_shape_conformance.sh` joins the whitelist, exclusions, censuses, and receipts, failing if any shape is unproven, receipt is stale/missing/blind, or an exclusion becomes stale (passes at cc >= 12 with RED controls). `--self-test` cleanly passes all 20 test fixtures. All relevant unit tests (`apr-cli`, `pmat785`, `prose_whitelist`, `capability_mirror`) pass.

PMAT-3968 review: PASS. The diff fully satisfies all acceptance criteria without weakening gates or expanding beyond ticket requirements. Census rows are machine-derived by scripts/lib/gguf_census.py; the shape conformance harness tests every held shape through the production BoundWeight::bind + CudaExecutor::bound_gemv dispatch against the CPU oracle with condition-aware tolerance (<= 1e-5) and verified negative controls; IQ3_S and IQ2_S are cleanly excluded at compute capability >= 12 failing closed; and check_gpu_shape_conformance.sh enforces anti-vacuity, receipt freshness, and exclusion staleness across all hosts.
